The spots are irregular, pale, almost chalky in appearance, distributed across the upper leaf surface. No brown necrotic lesions, no tip dieback, no dark sooty coating. This pattern strongly suggests Powdery_Mildew.

Let me view one reference from each class before confirming.
Excellent match — same whitish-gray powdery patches on green leaf surface, same distribution pattern. Now check the other classes.

Die_Back shows a completely brown, dried/dead stem/twig — totally different. Now Sooty_Mould.
Sooty_Mould shows dark/black sooty patches — the opposite of the pale white patches in the test image. Now I'll use remaining budget to confirm Powdery_Mildew with 2 more references.
Strong match again — same pale whitish circular patches on green leaf. Two more views to complete the budget.

Sooty_Mould shows dark brownish-black coating along the leaf margins — clearly different from the pale white patches in the test image.

All evidence is consistent. The test image matches Powdery_Mildew references exactly: pale white/gray chalky patches scattered across a green leaf surface, no necrosis, no dark coating, no tip dieback.
